death.note: saint.gr's head line reads «Οσια Νιννοκια η Εκ Βρετανιας (; - 467)» and the entry says she fell asleep in peace in 467. The page gives no year of birth and dates her life to the fifth century.

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 4 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and does not carry the «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. saint.gr's head line dates her «(; - 467)». The entry attributes her parentage to tradition and not to a record — «από την παράδοση θεωρείται θυγατέρα», she is held by tradition to be the daughter of Saint Brenthacius of Brecknock — and that hedge is the page's own. Brittany, Armorica and the monastery of Quimper are named, and `locations` is left out. Neither her father nor Germanus of Auxerre, whom she is said to have followed, has a folder in this corpus, so the life names them without a link and there is no `related` row. No hymn is printed.
